scenario: A telecom operator sells a bundle containing a handset and a 12-month network subscription for a single monthly fee.
vas_treatment: Doanh thu được ghi nhận theo hóa đơn xuất ra hàng tháng (tiền thu được). Handset thường không được tách biệt doanh thu ngay lập tức khi bàn giao.
ifrs_treatment: Allocate transaction price to the handset and the service obligation based on their standalone selling prices. Handset revenue is recognized upfront at delivery; service revenue is recognized monthly.

scenario: A retailer leases a store outlet for 5 years with fixed lease payments.
vas_treatment: Operating lease. Rentals are expensed on a straight-line basis over the lease term.
ifrs_treatment: Recognize a Right-of-Use asset and a Lease Liability at commencement. Monthly depreciation of ROU asset and interest expense on Lease Liability are recorded.
